entries.title: 극장 로비에서 기다려요
entries.scene: 표를 들고 로비 의자에 앉아 기다려요. 발 사이에 세운 네이비 백팩의 손잡이를 잡고 있어요.
entries.alt: 극장 로비에 앉아 네이비 No.1211 백팩 손잡이를 잡고 있는 사람을 위에서 본 AI 착용 연출

composition.framing: full seated body including both shoes with entire bag between feet
composition.activity: holding a ticket and the handles of a backpack standing on the floor

entries.fidelityReview: Direct source and generated comparison. Deep navy rounded body, paired navy handles with four dark rivets, small centered white wordmark, large rounded front pocket with two silver oval pulls at upper center, side pocket edges and black loose straps correspond to real source. Exterior 26 × 40 × 17 cm used for plausible body-to-bag scale. Both hands, seated legs and shoes checked. Output faces the camera and holds a ticket rather than reading it; scene wording matches actual output.

entries.prompt: Photorealistic natural editorial LookBook photo, portrait 2:3, 1024×1536. Use exact attached real navy Himawari No.1211 bag as strict reference, exterior 26 cm wide × 40 high × 17 deep. Fictional adult woman in a simple mustard sweater, cream trousers and brown shoes sits on a plain foyer bench in an unbranded cinema lobby, holding a small paper ticket in her right hand. Her left hand lightly grips the navy bag's original paired top handles. Bag stands upright on the clean floor between her feet and knees, front facing camera, original black backpack straps loose behind it and never worn across her front. Distinct elevated camera approximately 35 degrees above normal eye level, wide full seated body including both shoes, head and whole bag, graphic neutral floor around her and edge of bench, soft diffuse overhead light. Exact deep navy rounded rectangular fabric body, navy paired carry handles with four dark rivets, small white Himawari EST.2010 wordmark centered upper front, broad single rounded rectangular front zip pocket with two silver oval zipper pulls meeting at upper center, dark zip edging and navy side pockets with small black tabs. Preserve all original zipper and pocket counts and handle proportions. Bag about 30 percent of frame height, no new belts or ornaments, no invented interior, no extra logo, no readable posters or venue names. Natural anatomy and authentic bag shape.

entries.title: 길모퉁이에서 통화해요
entries.scene: 카키색 백팩을 메고 벽돌 담장 옆에서 통화해요. 앞 덮개와 검은 버클 끈 두 줄이 가까이 보여요.
entries.alt: 카키색 No.1010 백팩을 멘 채 벽돌 담장 옆에서 통화하는 사람의 옆뒤를 가까이 본 AI 착용 연출

entries.prompt: Photorealistic natural editorial LookBook portrait 1024×1536, 2:3 vertical. Strictly reproduce uploaded real Himawari No.1010 khaki backpack, exterior 33cm wide ×45cm tall ×15cm depth. Fictional middle-aged man with short wavy salt-and-pepper hair and plain rust overshirt over a navy shirt stands at a quiet brick street corner using a phone at his ear. Both original black padded backpack straps conventionally worn on his back. Frame close from upper head to hips, camera at shoulder height, side-rear three-quarter view with profile face at right and entire backpack front/back-facing exterior panel clear at left. Match reference pale muted khaki rectangular box shape with rounded corners, pair of black top handles joined by small dark keeper, two black strap attachments and oval dark double rings below handle ends, one broad front flap pocket, central small off-white rectangular Himawari label with black border, two dark vertical buckle straps with original round upper studs and punched lower tails on front flap. Preserve dark edging/main zip routing and black side tabs, no new zip pockets, no hanging accessories or clasp type changes. Bag 50–55 percent of frame height, plain softly blurred brick wall and pavement behind, cool natural shade, candid still pose with accurate fingers, one arm at side not hiding bag. Do not show invented open interior, logos or people in background.
